Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the expenditure of funds for the Interstate 5/Columbia river crossing/Vancouver project.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the expenditure of funds for the Interstate5/Columbia river crossing/Vancouver project; and adding a new sectionto chapter 47.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: State transportation funds may not be used for the Interstate5/Columbia river crossing/Vancouver project, unless the residents ofClark county approve a ballot measure that supports the following: (1)Expenditures of state funding for the Interstate 5/Columbia rivercrossing/Vancouver project; (2) expenditures for the light rail bridgeproject; and (3) tolling the Interstate 5/Columbia rivercrossing/Vancouver project.
